source_text: A systematic review of physical health outcomes associated with female genital cutting (FGC) classified by World Health Organization types reveals limited high-quality evidence linking the procedure directly to long-term morbidity, with many associations confounded by methodological weaknesses such as small samples, recall bias, and lack of controls for socioeconomic or environmental factors. [33]
